notes_for_editor: Thin record: the register and firelookout.com agree on 1937 and a platform tower; only the register says no longer standing (firelookout.com says only Abandoned), and neither says when it was abandoned, who staffed it, what fires it saw, or what remains today. The name 'High Rock' is shared with the standing Lewis County lookout (NHLR US 387, WA 47); the story warns readers. The Willhite northeast Washington list and the Forest Lookouts (Ron Kemnow) index mention this High Rock only as a name and a Township/Range reference, so they were not used as evidence. The record's status 'gone' and kind 'platform' are consistent with the sources; no corrections proposed. No photos or access source found; the record's access 'unknown' should stay unless a Kaniksu National Forest source is found.
